newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thai Airways sets ex-Germany cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways sets ex-Germany cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Thai Airways International Ltd said it has added a 15 pfennig a kilo fuel surcharge to its ex-Germany cargo prices with effect from November 4.
The airline's Germany cargo sales manager Guillermo Valencia said the surcharge was in line with the additional fee introduced by Lufthansa Cargo AG
"When the fuel price falls again, the surcharge will fall away," he told Reuters in a telephone interview.
The surcharge was being passed directly on by forwarders to shippers as an extra charge, he noted.

On Nov 1 Thai said it was planning a six pence per kg surcharge on ex-London cargo which would match an increase by British Airways due to take effect on Nov 8. Thai then said a final decision on the London surcharge would wait on the outcome of the IATA meeting on Nov 13. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
